items: [feature] Fix buttons have a mini workflow. After the confirm click every Fix button locks and a bar under the tabs (visible on every tab) says Scheduled (the command waits in the relay inbox: nothing runs yet, do not click again), In progress (Claude Code took it) and then Finished. Finished says honestly what happened: it lists the tasks that are still open and shows the Status line Claude Code wrote in its result (for example "partial: needs a play session"). The state comes from where the command file sits (inbox, running, done), read every 3 seconds.

[fix] One fix at a time. `fix_request.py` refuses a new fix while one is scheduled or in progress and names it, so a second click can neither pile up commands nor replace the prompt of one that is waiting. The confirm box moved out of the Tasks tab into the shared area under the tabs, so a click on the Performance or Audit tab shows its result where you are.
release.title: v1.121.3 — Fix buttons: Scheduled, In progress, Done
